_comment: Curated, un-inferable knowledge for marshal-infer. These built-in defaults (mirrored here for reference) cover glibc/zlib and are compiled in; pass --annotations <file> to EXTEND them per library. The general dataflow detectors live in the tool, not here. Fields: handle_types = DWARF struct name -> handle class (opaque, token-translated). allocators = fn base name (strip leading __ / __libc_) -> {"size_args":[idx...]} (byte size = product of those args) or {"force_local":true} (realloc-style). return_into_arg0 = searcher fn base names whose return is a pointer into arg0 (computed in a sibling TU, so undetectable by dataflow).
